name: Control Resonant
short_description: The sequel to Control — Dylan Faden loose in a Manhattan the Hiss has broken open, with a weapon that changes shape mid-fight.
description: Remedy's sequel to Control. Jesse's lockdown on the Oldest House has failed, and her brother Dylan, years a test subject of the Bureau, is let out into a Manhattan that the Hiss and the Mold are rewriting street by street. Gravity tilts, buildings fold in on themselves, and the Aberrant — a melee weapon that goes from a two-handed hammer to twin blades on demand — does the work alongside his powers, which grow the way you choose. Single-player from start to finish.

name: Silent Hill: Townfall
short_description: The first Silent Hill played in first person — a fog-bound Scottish island town in 1996, and a pocket TV that picks up what happened there.
description: Simon Ordell goes back to St. Amelia, an island town off the coast of Scotland, to put something right, and finds it under fog and not quite empty. Sneak past what you can, fight what you cannot with a few melee weapons and guns, and tune the CRTV — a portable television standing in for the series' old radio — into signals that warn of what is close and replay the town's past. A self-contained story, so no earlier Silent Hill is needed. Single-player.

name: Gears of War: E-Day
short_description: Emergence Day, fourteen years before the first game — Marcus and Dom's origin story. Campaign only.
description: The day the Locust came up through the ground, fourteen years before the original Gears of War, played as a young Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago. Rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5 with a darker tone that leans towards horror, the cover shooting the series is known for, and new movement — vaulting, sliding, flanking — on top of it. Horde Siege, Versus and online co-op need a live connection, so an offline account is the campaign, played solo.

name: Phantom Blade Zero Digital Deluxe Edition
short_description: Pre-order, out 28 October 2026. Kungfupunk action with thirty-odd weapons — the Deluxe adds two outfits, the artbook and the soundtrack.
description: Soul is framed for his master's murder and left with sixty-six days to live, and spends them cutting through the Wulin after the people behind it. S-Game's action RPG is wuxia cinema crossed with punk machinery: over thirty weapons, twenty-odd Phantom Edges taken off fallen enemies, and fights choreographed by martial-arts film veterans and decided on the parry. The Digital Deluxe Edition adds the Wulin Legend and Blood-Steel Form outfits, the digital artbook and the soundtrack. The game releases on 28 October 2026; until then this is a pre-order. Single-player.

name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
short_description: Open-world dark fantasy from the director of The Witcher 3 — human by day, vampire by night, and not enough time to save everyone.
description: Fourteenth-century Europe, with the Black Death thinning out the living and vampires stepping out of the shadows to take what is left. Coen has been turned into a Dawnwalker, a man by day and a vampire by night, and his family's days are numbered. Every quest moves the clock forward, so you choose whom to help and whom to leave behind. By day it is sword and magic; by night, vampire powers that ignore gravity — each with its own strengths, and the fights change with them. Rebel Wolves' first game, led by The Witcher 3's director, built in Unreal Engine 5. Single-player.
